name: Power Supply Hoden Sentai Donuts
dimensionsSource: Effects Bakery USA product page (official): 94 W × 39 D × 35 H mm including projections; catalog footprint 9.4 × 3.9 cm.
color: Light blue with printed Power Station Donuts character artwork
notes: Ten-output center-negative 9 V DC power supply in a mini-pedal-size enclosure, powered by the included 9 V DC 2 A adapter. Ships with ten DC cables (1 × 15 cm, 3 × 30 cm, 3 × 50 cm, 3 × 70 cm).

jacks.label: DC 9V 2A input
jacks.note: Single center-negative 9 V DC 2 A input on the left short end; use the included Effects Bakery 9 V DC 2 A adapter.

jacks.label: DC OUT (front)
jacks.note: Five center-negative 9 V DC 200 mA outputs on the front long face (manual page 1 and official JP product image 00.png).

jacks.label: DC OUT (opposite face)
jacks.note: The remaining five of the ten outputs are on the opposite long face; no official photo of that face was found, so its edge is omitted rather than inferred.

jackLayout.note: Official Effects Bakery manual: the DC 9 V input is on the left side (page 1, label 1) and the DC OUT jacks are on a long side face (page 1, label 2). The manual and the official JP image 00.png show five outputs on the front face; the opposite five are not shown, so that edge is omitted.

power.note: DC 9 V 2 A center-negative input via the included adapter.

power.acInput: DC 9 V 2 A center-negative (included Effects Bakery 9VDC adapter)
power.note: Ten center-negative 9 V DC outputs at up to 200 mA each. The official product page and manual do not state whether the outputs are isolated; isolation is left unknown and is not claimed.

physical.jackOrientation: DC input on the left short end; DC outputs on the long side faces.
physical.mounting: Mini pedal footprint; mounts on a pedalboard

imageProvenance.note: Official Effects Bakery (US store) product photo, 2000×2000 px; trimmed to the enclosure (1837×812 px) and downscaled 2.3× to the 800×354 AVIF master (no upscale). The branded top face was confirmed in the single vision pass; the 02_… connector-face photo was rejected as a side elevation.

extra.isolation: Not stated by the manufacturer on the official product page or in the manual; the unit is fed by one 9 V 2 A adapter. Isolation is recorded as unknown, not claimed.
